{{Top|Lotus|Tenno|Tenno|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|A classic Tenno sniper rifle, the Vectis is ideal for ranged takedowns.}} The '''Vectis''' is a high-powered, single-shot, breech-loading sniper rifle. Its single shot behavior provides a bolt-action feel. With significantly less zoom compared to other sniper rifles, it is much better suited for medium-range combat. This weapon can be sold for {{cc|7,500}}. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Impact}} damage. *Two zoom modes: **First zoom has 3.0x zoom distance and +30% headshot damage. **Second zoom has 4.5x zoom distance and +50% headshot damage. **Zoom is not cancelled during reload. *Innate {{Pol|Madurai}} polarity. *Good candidate for {{M|Charged Chamber}} and/or {{M|Primed Chamber}} due to its magazine size of one round. {{Advantages|class=Sniper Rifle| *Good [[ammo]] economy. *Pinpoint [[accuracy]] while [[zoom]]ed in; shots will hit exactly on the reticle dot, perfect for [[Enemy Body Parts|headshots]]. *Innate 1 meter [[punch through]]. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Sniper Rifle| *Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% from 400m to 600m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *Extremely low magazine size of one round; must reload after every shot. *High [[recoil]], which may make it difficult to fire a follow-up shot, especially at higher zoom levels. }} {{WeaponComparison|Vectis Prime}} **Lower [[zoom]] distance (3x/4.5x vs. 3.5x/6x) **Lower zoom headshot damage (30%/50% vs. 40%/60%) ==Acquisition== The Vectis's blueprint can be purchased from the [[Market]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *Unlike other sniper rifles, such as the {{Weapon|Lanka}} or the {{Weapon|Vulkar}}, the Vectis can reload while zoomed in, allowing for continuous shots without having to re-sight the target. *The Vectis has to reload after each shot, which resembles the way a bolt-action sniper rifle works in other shooters. *Cannot use {{M|Emergent Aftermath}}. *Requires only 1 scoped shot to activate its [[Sniper Rifle|Shot Combo Counter]], giving it an '''immediate''' 1.5x total damage bonus registering on the first hit. In other words, it '''always''' does 1.5x total damage or more when scoped. ==Incarnon Genesis== {{Transclude|Vectis Incarnon Genesis#Acquisition}} {{Transclude|Vectis Incarnon Genesis#Incarnon Genesis}} ==Tips== *Equipping {{M|Charged Chamber}} and/or {{M|Primed Chamber}} provides a bonus damage on every shot, since every round is the first of the single-round magazine. *Due to reloading after every shot (or every 2 shots if using Wildfire and Magazine Warp), improving the reload speed will be of more use than fire rate. *A magazine size of 2 can be reached by equipping both a max rank {{M|Wildfire}} and a max rank {{M|Magazine Warp}}. *The Vectis automatically reloads once the weapon finishes its recoil animation. However pressing the reload key immediately after each shot can start the reload early. With practice, this method can shorten the downtime between shots significantly. ==Trivia== *Despite the fact that this came in last place in the Primary Weapon Content Development poll held in the Design Council, it was released before the {{Weapon|Tigris}}, which had placed second place (the {{Weapon|Soma}} was the primary weapon that came in first place in that poll). *There is some contention in regards to how the Vectis' action works, but it appears to be classifiable as a breach-loading, single-shot rifle. **The weapon apparently fires caseless rounds. *When reloading, the Tenno appears to insert something (likely a new round) into the receiver of the Vectis. The rear portion of the upper assembly appears to automatically rise after firing. The Tenno will smack this assembly down after loading the round. *The series of hoops along the top of the rifle are a sighting system, but how it works is not obvious, suggesting a sensor and neural link is used to provide zoom. *The Vectis is the first true Tenno-made sniper rifle, the others being made by either the Corpus or the Grineer.  *[[wiktionary:vectis|Vectis]] is Latin for "Bar" or "Pole", referring to a locking bar (or bolt), a leveraging bar such as a Crowbar, or possibly referring to a carrying pole. *When {{M|Depleted Reload}} was first introduced, equipping it on the Vectis would reduce the magazine size to zero, causing the Vectis to draw directly from its ammo reserves and allowing it to fire very quickly. This was fixed in {{ver|17.0.3}}; now the Vectis is the only sniper rifle unaffected by the mod's penalty. ==Media== File:Vectis -1.png|Vectis, as it appears in the arsenal File:Vectis 2.png File:Vectis 3.png Vectis_scope.jpg|View through Vectis scope   {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|UeK9_p0tr04|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|ndgYbRJpWeg|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|Uub7Mjer8nk|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|6zY3TOlnq7k|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|37.0.1}} *Fixed the Vectis clipping into Koumei when holstered. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 15 Ammo per Pick Up: *Vectis {{ver|30.9}} *Fixed weapons with 1 bullet in their magazine (such as Vectis) bypassing the Fire Rate limit if equipped with a max rank Arcane Pistoleer. {{ver|22.12}} *Mastery Rank decreased from 3 to 2. {{ver|22.0.6}} *Reduced the headshot damage of the Vectis series in Conclave. {{ver|Plains of Eidolon}} ;General Sniper Changes: *Reticle sway removed from all zoom levels! *1 meter punch through added to all snipers without any to start with (snipers with innate punch through unchanged). *1 combo count removed at a time when duration runs out instead of all of them (decay vs. cooldown). *1 combo count removed on miss instead of all of them. *Additional bullets from multishot will each count as their own hits and misses in the combo counter. *Combo duration reduced to 2 seconds for all snipers apart from Lanka which is reduced to 6. *Damage fall off begins at 400 meters and ends at 600 meters with damage reduced to 50% past 600 meters. ;Specific Sniper Weapon Changes: Vectis *First level zoom +10% Damage replaced with +30% Head Shot Damage. *Second level zoom 15% Damage replaced with +50% Head Shot Damage. {{ver|10.7}} *Removed .25 second delay for auto reloading the Vectis. {{ver|10.6}} *Introduced. }} ==See Also== *{{Weapon|Vectis Prime}}, the Prime counterpart of this gun {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Vectis]] [[es:Vectis]] [[fr:Vectis]] [[Category:Sniper Rifle]] [[Category:Tenno]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Update 10]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Impact Damage Weapons]] [[Category:Single-Shot]] [[uk:Вектис]]

{{Top|Enemy|Infested|Infested|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|The Tysis pistol spits out caustic darts that corrode their victims from within.}} The '''Tysis''' is an [[Infested]] sidearm that fires {{D|Corrosive}} darts that deals damage over time supported by its incredibly high [[status chance]] that allows it to wear down even the heaviest of [[armor]] with ease, but has low [[critical]] stats. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Corrosive}} damage. *On kill, bodies will follow the dart that killed them, damaging anyone in their path and pinning the corpse to walls. {{Advantages| *Tied with uncharged {{Weapon|Epitaph}}, {{Weapon|Kuva Nukor}} for the highest [[status chance]] of all secondaries. Innate {{D|Corrosive}} damage can rapidly strip away [[armor]]. *Pinpoint [[accuracy]]. }} {{Disadvantages| *Projectiles have travel time. *Fairly high recoil. }} {{WeaponComparison|Coda Tysis}} ==Acquisition== The Tysis's blueprint can be purchased from the [[Market]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} This weapon can be sold for ‍{{cc|2,500}}. ==Notes== *The 81 {{D|Corrosive}} damage is dealt in 3 ticks of 27 damage, over the course of 2 seconds. This allows a single dart to proc multiple times. **Each multishot creates DoT individually. **If the dart [[Punch Through|punches through]] an enemy, they will instead receive 1 tick. *Tysis needles retain their course after piercing their first target, possibly penetrating multiple targets without losing accuracy. *Tysis needles will be invisible if the energy color is Black, making target leading harder as you can't estimate travel speed and deviation effectively. *The in-game arsenal is incorrect, as it indicates a single attack containing 9 {{D|Impact}}, 23 {{D|Puncture}}, 17 {{D|Slash}}, and 27 {{D|Corrosive}} damage with an unspecified DoT effect and a second attack containing 40 {{D|Impact}}. In truth, the second attack doesn't exist, the primary projectile attack only uses the specified physical damage types and values, and the DoT effect only uses the stated {{D|Corrosive}} damage. As such, the base damage listed in-game (76) is incorrect as it is split between the two attacks (49 and 27, respectively). ==Tips== *A [[status chance]] of 260% may be obtained without any riven mods by combining {{M|Stunning Speed}}, {{M|Sure Shot}}, {{M|Jugulus Spines}} or {{M|Carnis Stinger}}, {{M|Jolt}}, {{M|Pistol Pestilence}}, {{M|Scorch|Scorch}} and {{M|Frostbite}} (for a maximum of 305% with {{M|Embedded Catalyzer}}). *With its high status chance, the Tysis may be used as a softening weapon against [[Grineer]]. Corrosive effects stack, allowing another weapon to easily deliver the killing blow. *The Tysis' main advantage over other status primer secondaries (eg. [[Kompressa]], [[Epitaph]]) is its pinpoint accuracy; this is especially relevant when using {{A|Xata's Whisper}}, as {{D|Void}} status effects inflicted upon the body make it impossible to land headshots with your main damage-dealing weapon. *When using {{Arcane|Cascadia Empowered}}, only the initial hit can trigger the bonus damage on status effect. ==Trivia== *The Tysis' needles may stretch targets if they are already pinned to the wall by another weapon's projectile (like the {{Weapon|Boltor}}). *This is the second [[Infested]] weapon available on the [[Market]]. The first was the {{Weapon|Mire}}. **The Tysis is the first Infested sidearm to be non-clan exclusive. * The Tysis may derive its name from the suffix "[http://www.merriam-webster.com/medical/-ptysis -ptysis]", which typically refers to spitting out substances (e.g. [[wikipedia:Hemoptysis|Hemoptysis]] would refer to spitting blood). It may also be based on Phthisis, the ancient Greek name for Consumption, AKA Tuberculosis, which was named such for "eating its victims from the inside". *The head of the Tysis vaguely resembles the head of a [[wikipedia:Goblin Shark|Goblin shark]]. ==Media== Warframe0278.jpg|In the Codex tysisdarthmufin.png|Tysis With Infested Color Pack Tysis Arsenal.jpg|Tysis in the Arsenal Tysis.jpg|Tysis
{{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|3oF9o1z-EuA|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|4_IRGC6bauQ|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|_nnyswOXOtY|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|QdAP7lHsksE|size=300px}} }} ==Update History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|25}} *Tysis Corrosive Damage-over-time will now be apply a single tick to targets the projectile punches through. {{ver|24.6}} *Damage changed from 79 Corrosive to 9 Impact, 23 Puncture, 17 Slash and 81 Corrosive delivered in 3 ticks of 27 each over 2 seconds. {{ver|23.1.2}} *Fixed a visual bug with the Tysis' dangles getting tangled. {{ver|22.12}} *Mastery Rank increased from 4 to 9. *Damage increased from 35 to 79. *Critical chance increased from 2.5% to 3%. *Improved Projectile trail FX. *Mag size decreased from 15 to 11. {{ver|11.7}} *Introduced. }} {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Tysis]] [[es:Tysis]] [[fr:Tysis]] [[Category:Single Sidearm]] [[Category:Corrosive Damage Weapons]] [[Category:Secondary Weapons]] [[Category:Update 11]] [[Category:Infested]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Infested Weapons]] [[uk:Тайзис]]

The '''Vaykor Marelok''' is a {{Weapon|Marelok}} variant available only from {{Faction|Steel Meridian}}. Boasting a larger magazine, [[critical chance]] and [[status chance]], the Vaykor Marelok also comes with an innate [[Justice]] effect.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Impact}} damage.
*Innate [[Justice]] effect.
*Can use the Marelok-exclusive {{M|Shrapnel Rounds}} mod.
*Innate {{Pol|Madurai}} and {{Pol|Vazarin}} polarity.

{{Advantages|
*Very good ammunition efficiency.
}}

{{Disadvantages|
*High recoil.
}}

{{WeaponComparison|Marelok}}

==Acquisition==
*The Vaykor Marelok can be acquired by reaching the Rank of '''General''' with {{Faction|Steel Meridian}}, and spending {{sc|100,000}} to purchase. As with all Syndicate Weapons, the Vaykor Marelok cannot be chosen as the free offering upon ranking up to General rank.
*Syndicate weapons can also be acquired via [[Trade System|Trading]], but only for unranked copies without [[Forma]] or [[Orokin Catalyst]] installed.
*Players must have a [[Mastery Rank]] of at least 10 to acquire the Vaykor Marelok, either through trading or through the Syndicates themselves.

==Tips==
*The Vaykor Marelok is a great side arm for dealing with enemies at short to mid range for players who have a sniper rifle or bow for their primary weapon. Vaykor Marelok's firepower is strong enough to be considered a sub-primary weapon.
*In order to reach the full fire-rate, one must fire the next shot just before the "lever-action" animation is completed.
*The innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} polarity can somewhat limit elemental modding potential, thus making it a less desirable polarity for elemental modding. If you wish to focus more on elemental damage, then it is recommended to either ignore the polarity or use [[Forma]] to turn it into a more suitable polarity.
**However, the high [[status chance]] can actually make the weapon proc very often, making {{M|Deep Freeze}} a very easy way to slow down enemies.
**Alternatively, {{M|Sure Shot}} (or {{M|Galvanized Shot}}) can be placed into this slot to further boost the status chance (and damage).

==Trivia==
*Prior to update 15.13, you were unable to alter the cyan Energy color.
*When stolen by the [[Drahk Master]], as with all Syndicate weapons, it reverts to its original variant's skin when left on the ground.
**The Vaykor Marelok skin returns once picked back up.
*Unlike the other five Syndicate weapons, the word 'vaykor' appears to not be a derivative word or have any meaning, although there is a possibility it is a Grineer corruption of the word "valor."
*The Vaykor Marelok was the first item to have the "''Vaykor''" prefix, with the [[Vaykor Syandana]] being the second.

{{Top|Enemy|Grineer|Grineer|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Forged in the fires of rebel struggle, this shotgun is a force for liberation.}} The '''Vaykor Hek''' is a {{Weapon|Hek}} variant available only from {{Faction|Steel Meridian}}. Boasting double the magazine capacity of the base variant, a faster rate of fire, and an increased [[critical chance]], the Vaykor Hek also comes with an innate [[Justice]] effect. It does, however, take slightly longer to reload than the base variant. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage. *Innate [[multishot]] of 7 pellets. *Innate [[Justice]] effect. *Cannot use the {{Weapon|Hek}}-exclusive {{M|Scattered Justice}} mod. *Innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} and {{Pol|Madurai}} polarities. {{Advantages|class=Shotgun| *Tied with normal {{Weapon|Hek}} and {{Weapon|Corinth}} for the second-narrowest pellet spread of all shotguns, behind {{Weapon|Exergis}}. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Shotgun| *Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 26.67% from 10m to 25m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *High recoil. }} {{WeaponComparison|Hek}} {{WeaponComparison|Kuva Hek|header="n"}} ==Acquisition== *The Vaykor Hek can be acquired by reaching the Rank of '''General''' with {{Faction|Steel Meridian}}, and spending {{sc|125,000}} to purchase. As with all Syndicate Weapons, the Vaykor Hek cannot be chosen as the free offering upon ranking up to General rank. *Syndicate weapons can also be acquired via [[Trade System|Trading]], but only for unranked copies without [[Forma]] and [[Orokin Catalyst]] installed. *Players must have a [[Mastery Rank]] of at least 12 to acquire the Vaykor Hek, either through trading or through the Syndicates themselves. ==Notes== *Can make good use of {{M|Accelerated Blast}}, due to its high innate {{D|Puncture}} damage. == Tips== *The Vaykor Hek has over double the critical potential of the normal {{Weapon|Hek}}. This, combined with more rounds per magazine and a higher fire rate, means the Vaykor variant is more viable for a critical oriented build, and more powerful overall even with Hek's extra multishot afforded by {{M|Scattered Justice}}. ==Media== MeridianHek.png|Vaykor Hek in Codex. File:Vaykor Hek 1.png|Vaykor Hek, when equipped in the arsenal File:Vaykor Hek 2.png| File:Vaykor Hek 3.png| {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|6-cpgdCiErQ|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|MfBrF9g-zsM|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|g0_nqmMEkc8|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|wV3JAIEvkB8|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 15 Ammo per Pick Up: *Vaykor Hek {{ver|27.2}} ;Greater than 100% Status having meaning: Shotguns have a unique Role here based on a very patch-work history with how they interact with Status Chance. A Shotgun that shoots 99% Status Chance would give you 35% (roughly) status per pellet. 100% Status Gives you 100% Status per pellet. This huge jump in performance happens with just a 1% gain - why? Well, to answer that we have to look at our choice to make what the UI conveys reality. It would feel broken to shoot a Shotgun with 100% Status and not see a perfect spread of Effects. In reality, to make Status consistent we have to treat Shotguns as a special case. Shotguns as a special case means we have buffed the Status Chance of all Shotguns by x3 or greater. The UI now behaves to show the reality that you are determining Status Chance per pellet. *(Undocumented) Status chance increased from {{#expr: 25/7}}% to {{#expr: (25/7) * 3}}%. {{ver|17.3}} *Introduced. }} ==See Also== *{{Weapon|Hek}}, the normal counterpart of this weapon. *{{Weapon|Kuva Hek}}, the [[Kuva (Variant)|Kuva]] counterpart of this weapon. *{{Weapon|Vaykor Marelok}}, the Steel Meridian pistol counterpart. *{{Weapon|Vaykor Sydon}}, the Steel Meridian melee counterpart. *{{Faction|Steel Meridian}}, the [[Syndicate]] that offers this weapon. *[[Syndicate Weapons]], for other weapons from the Syndicates. {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Vaykor Hek]] [[es:Hek Vaykor]] [[Category:Update 17]] [[Category:Syndicate Offerings]] [[Category:Shotgun]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Puncture Damage Weapons]] [[Category:Special Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Grineer]] [[Category:Syndicate Weapons]] [[uk:Гек-вейкор]]

{{ResourceInfobox}} '''Vasto Incarnon Genesis''' is an item that is used to add [[Incarnon]] upgrades to the {{Weapon|Vasto}} or {{Weapon|Vasto Prime}}. ==Acquisition== *Upon completion of [[The Duviri Paradox]] and [[Angels of the Zariman]], and unlocking [[The Steel Path]], players can earn {{Resource|Vasto Incarnon Genesis}} from [[The Circuit]]'s Steel Path to place on their Vasto with the help of [[Cavalero]] in the [[Chrysalith]]. This [[Incarnon Genesis]] form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength. *Purchased from Cavalero for {{pc|120}}, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made '''once'''. ==Incarnon Genesis== *Installing the Vasto Incarnon Genesis requires 20 {{Resource|Pathos Clamp|Pathos Clamps}}, 70 {{Resource|Yao Shrub}}, and 150 {{Resource|Saggen Pearl}}. **When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. {{Codex|Caliban Prime's signature sniper rifle is no mere ceremonial weapon. A sign, perhaps, that peace between Orokin and Sentient was destined to be fleeting. Struck enemies become lightning rods, with a chance to attract bolts of chain lightning that can jump to nearby enemies.}}
'''Vadarya Prime''' is a standalone [[Prime]]d [[Sentient]] sniper rifle that charges up to fire {{D|Electricity}} blasts that has a chance to strike nearby targets with lightning bolts. Vadarya Prime was released alongside {{WF|Caliban Prime}} and {{Weapon|Venato Prime}}.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals pure {{D|Electricity}} damage.
*Charge-up is automatic and will automatically fire unless the trigger is held.
*Two zoom modes:
** First zoom uses standard aim-down sights, with 2.5x zoom distance.
***Shots in this mode do not build shot combo, but do benefit from the damage increase.
**Second zoom uses scoped zoom, with 8x zoom distance and +50% critical damage.
***Reloading does not break zoom, unlike most other sniper rifles.
*Damaging an enemy has a '''30%''' chance to spawn '''0''' lightning strikes, a '''35%''' chance to spawn '''1''' lightning strike, a '''17.5%''' chance to spawn '''2''' lightning strikes, and a '''17.5%''' chance to spawn '''3''' lightning strikes that target enemies within '''10''' meters of the initial target. Failing to trigger a lightning strike for '''3''' hits will guarantee the next hit to spawn a lightning strike.
**Lightning will strike enemies in the same plane as the original target. When hitting an enemy in the [[Rift]] - only rifted enemies will be targeted, and vice versa.
**Damage, critical, and status of the lightning strikes are identical to the primary fire and are affected by mods.
***Damage is '''not''' affected by {{M|Galvanized Aptitude}}.
***Lightning strike targeting range is '''not''' affected by {{M|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}).
***[[Multishot]] and [[Punch Through]] are considered separate hits and individually have a chance to spawn the lightning strikes.
**Lightning does not have a "Projectile", and instead will directly damage the target's body with the location chosen depending on if the original attack was a headshot.
***Head shots will target the weak point of surrounding enemies.
***Body shots will instead target the "Center of Mass", but can still hit head shots on some targets, such as [[Bursa]] enemies.
*Innate {{Pol|Madurai}} and {{Pol|Naramon}} polarities.

==Notes==
*Damaging an enemy has a '''70%''' chance to spawn a lightning strike. The first lighting strike has a '''50%''' chance to chain a lightning strike on a different target, which then itself has a '''50%''' chance to spawn a chain lightning strike on a different target to the second strike.
**Lightning can only chain twice.
**Lightning prefers to strike a different target from the initial one shot. The more enemies are nearby, the lower the chance of the initial target being struck by the first lightning bolt.
**If no other enemies are in range of the initial target, lightning that spawns will hit the initial target but then cannot chain/repeat.
**Chain distance is from each target struck. A target out of range of the first can be struck by lightning if enough other targets bridge the gap between them.
**A lightning strike is guaranteed to spawn after failing to trigger it after '''3''' hits.
*The {{M|Sharpshooter}} mod triggers its energy restore from headshot kills made by the lightning strikes.

==Trivia==
*Vadarya Prime is the first sniper rifle that has aim-down sights as one of its zoom modes.
*Vadarya Prime is the third sniper rifle, after {{Weapon|Vectis}} and {{Weapon|Vectis Prime}}, where reload does not cancel scoped zoom.
*Vadarya Prime is likely a living Sentient, having visible eyes directly above the forward grip point.
*"Vadarya" may be a corruption of vadara, the name for a surface composed of up to 93% quartz, which can be used to create piezoelectricity, an electrical charge generated in response to mechanical stress, and pyroelectricity, an electrical charge generated in response to temperature changes, thus tying into the weapon's pure Electricity damage.

==Incarnon Genesis==

'''5''' weakpoint hits will completely fill the gauge. A full gauge is not required to activate Incarnon Form, but total Incarnon charges will be reduced if activating with a partial gauge.
